mandate: C424 — test the price-only IESD: inter-extremum spacing distribution (mean spacing and spacing entropy of local-extremum gaps) stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. Over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing closes C=c_i[t-W..t]: mark each interior position k in 1..W-1 a local max if C[k]>C[k-1] and C[k]>C[k+1], a local min if C[k]<C[k-1] and C[k]<C[k+1] (strict; ties not extrema); extremum times e_1<...<e_M; spacings g_m=e_{m+1}-e_m (bars); ies_mean_spacing=mean(g); ies_spacing_ent=-sum_k p_k log p_k, p_k=freq(spacing==k)/(M-1). NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in C[t-W..t], M<2, or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 4 real (ies_mean_spacing_dev, ies_spacing_ent_dev) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W+1-bar close window).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing closes C=c_i[t-W..t]; local-extremum position k in 1..W-1: local max if C[k]>C[k-1] and C[k]>C[k+1], local min if C[k]<C[k-1] and C[k]<C[k+1] (strict; ties not extrema); extremum times e_1<...<e_M; spacings g_m=e_{m+1}-e_m (bars); ies_mean_spacing=mean(g); ies_spacing_ent=-sum_k p_k log p_k, p_k=freq(spacing==k)/(M-1).
methodology.signals: ies_mean_spacing/ies_spacing_ent over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.iesd_vectorization_note: close matrix C=(T,10) built once; per asset, local-extremum flags computed once over the whole series; per-window spacing extraction via searchsorted over extremum positions in bounded chunks; mean spacing from prefix sums of the global spacing array; spacing entropy from prefix counts of each distinct spacing value; global W+1-bar finiteness gate; validated against brute-force per-window loop with explicit extrema + spacing + entropy, maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
